response.query: Which methods most effectively propagate classification, transition and model-structural uncertainty end-to-end from LULC to hydrology and ES valuation?
response.answer: Ensemble methods like Random Forest and XGBoost, combined with physically based hydrological models like MIKE SHE, effectively propagate classification, transition, and model-structural uncertainty from LULC to hydrology and ES valuation. Deep learning approaches also show promise in this domain.
